title: Variant 1
image_prompt: The same matte forest-green vacuum-insulated stainless steel growler with its metal swing carry handle and chunky screw cap, resting on a weathered wooden picnic table at a campsite at golden hour. Warm cinematic backlight rakes across the trees and glows through a faint mist, shallow depth of field blurs pine trees and a soft campfire glow in the background, condensation glistens on the bottle in the low sun. A hand rests loosely on the handle mid-reach. Cozy, adventurous, end-of-day mood, rich warm tones.
caption: End of the trail, still cold.
score_reason: The image has strong subject clarity and a warm, inviting composition, but the presence of a human hand slightly detracts from the overall brand safety.
